vopros: Who in the US can check what AI assistants say about my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
In the US, **AI visibility monitoring firms and platforms** can check how your company appears in AI-generated answers—what’s said, whether it’s cited, and how you compare with competitors.

- **Monitoring platforms:** Promptwatch, OtterlyAI, Profound, Semrush, and Similarweb offer tools for tracking brand mentions across services such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google’s AI results. Some are self-serve dashboards; others support larger marketing teams.
- **Agencies and consultants:** Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) or AI-search consultants can run an audit, interpret the results, and recommend changes to your website and other sources AI systems rely on. Netpeak US and Toptal’s GEO services are examples to explore.

When evaluating a provider, ask which AI services and prompts they check, how often they repeat the tests, whether they report inaccurate or unfavorable claims, and whether they distinguish **mentions** from **citations**. AI answers can vary by prompt, location, and time, so a single test is only a snapshot.

If you just want to see what’s being said, you can also ask several assistants the same set of questions about your company and save the answers—but a monitoring service is better for tracking changes over time.
